published_record_corrections.title: Technical University of Munich International Scholarship
published_record_corrections.finding: TUM's named Scholarship for International Students is a one-off €500–€1,800 per semester (reapplication possible). Winter 2026/27 application period 1–15 Oct 2026. Eligible enrolled TUM Bachelor students from semester 3, Master students from semester 2 (or first semester after TUM Bachelor), ineligible for BAföG due to nationality, merit and need. 2027 cycle not yet published. Distinguish this from TUM Deutschlandstipendium (€300/month).

field_provenance.finding: One-off €500–€1,800 per semester; 1–15 Oct 2026 winter call; not a universal €7,560 annual grant.
New non-EU/EEA Bachelor/Master students generally pay tuition unless exempt/waived.

published_record_corrections.proposed_action: Correct existing record after authenticated evidence review, do NOT create a duplicate.

published_record_corrections.title: University of Vienna Masters International Scholarship
published_record_corrections.finding: No official programme-specific source found for a universal Master's award matching this claim. University tuition depends on nationality/status; €1,050/month appears on a restricted PHYSICS PhD completion scholarship, not a general Master's scholarship.

field_provenance.finding: Non-EU/EEA students generally pay €726.72 tuition + €26.20 student union fee per semester, subject to exemptions.
€1,050 monthly is a restricted doctoral completion scholarship; not general Master's support.

published_record_corrections.proposed_action: Hold needs_review, establish exact named programme or recommend authorized archival after identity review.

published_record_corrections.title: University of Vienna Phd International Scholarship
published_record_corrections.existing_claim: Fully funded full tuition + €1,050/month for unrestricted international PhD students
published_record_corrections.finding: VDSP Physics completion scholarship (€1,050/month for up to six months) requires existing active Vienna Physics PhD enrollment and advanced thesis; it does NOT pay tuition/insurance and is not a general incoming PhD scholarship. Page has inconsistent Nov 2 vs Nov 9 deadline across indexed/current views and says 'Call is CLOSED'; hold deadline pending clarification.

field_provenance.finding: Restricted completion stipend, no tuition or health cover, 6 months maximum; separate employment contract option must not be treated as a grant.
Tuition obligations and exemptions vary by nationality and employment.

published_record_corrections.proposed_action: Do not transform generic award into VDSP without programme identity proof; keep needs_review.

published_record_corrections.title: NTNU International Scholarship
published_record_corrections.existing_claim: No tuition fees for all students; NTNU scholarship for PhD
published_record_corrections.finding: NTNU explicitly states it offers no tuition scholarships or discounts. Non-EU/EEA/Swiss Master's students generally pay tuition, with limited exemptions. PhD candidates are tuition-exempt, but salaried doctoral employment is not an independent scholarship.

field_provenance.finding: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss tuition applies; NTNU offers no tuition scholarships.
NTNU generally does not offer scholarships or loans; third-party funding may exist.

published_record_corrections.proposed_action: High-priority false-listing review; archive only through authenticated audited workflow once exact record identity is confirmed.

published_record_corrections.title: Waterloo International Experience Award
published_record_corrections.existing_claim: C$10,000 scholarship for talented students from developing countries
published_record_corrections.finding: University of Waterloo's International Experience Award APPLICATION is an umbrella for approved outbound international travel by already enrolled undergraduate students. Typical awards C$500–2,500; not a C$10,000 general entrance scholarship and no developing-country restriction documented. Fall main deadline July 15, Winter Nov 15, Spring March 15 (year-independent recurring term deadlines).

field_provenance.finding: C$500–2,500 typical; approved outbound travel and active undergraduate enrollment; term-based application dates.

published_record_corrections.proposed_action: Correct funding and eligibility after verifying whether umbrella award is appropriate catalog unit; do not confuse with distinct C$1,500 President's International Experience Award.
